title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies | TechCrunch
summary: The Dallas-based investment firm Disruptive, whose past bets include Palantir, Airbnb, and Spotify, announced a $10 billion fund to back at least 10 late-stage companies, with checks of up to $1 billion, it said Tuesday .
